title: Grilled Halloumi Salad
subtitle: Seared halloumi with tomatoes, olives, and mint
excerpt: Thick slices of halloumi are seared until golden and served over a salad of cherry tomatoes, cucumber, yellow pepper, black olives, and fresh mint. A sharp red wine vinegar dressing ties it together. Ready in under 20 minutes.
sourceNotes: Inspired by Mediterranean grilled cheese salads. Halloumi's high melting point makes it ideal for pan-frying without oil.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Prepare the salad and dressing up to 2 hours ahead. Grill the halloumi just before serving.

content.text: Cook the halloumi in a completely dry pan over high heat. No oil is needed. The cheese will release its own fat and develop a golden crust.
Make the dressing. Whisk the olive oil, red wine vinegar, lemon juice, and chilli flakes together. Season with a pinch of salt.
Combine the cherry tomatoes, cucumber, yellow pepper, black olives, and mint in a large bowl. Pour over two-thirds of the dressing. Toss to coat.
Heat a dry frying pan over high heat. When very hot, add the halloumi slices in a single layer.
Cook for 2 minutes without moving until golden and slightly charred. Flip and cook for 2 more minutes.
Arrange the dressed salad on a platter. Lay the warm halloumi over the top. Drizzle with the remaining dressing. Serve at once.

items.symptom: Halloumi is sticking to the pan
items.cause: Pan not hot enough when cheese was added
items.fix: Let the pan get very hot before adding halloumi.

items.cause: Too much moisture or heat too low
items.fix: Pat dry first and use a very high heat.

items.cause: Cucumber released water into the dressing
items.fix: Dress the salad just before serving.
